svg.title: Grimoire feature matrix design proposal
svg.desc: Planning sketch showing all119 current feature labels as a grouped linked index. Search and category navigation are proposed controls; no functionality is implemented.
svg.text: Select a feature to read how it works.
Filter by status, source and type
Keep novels after removing a source
Light, sepia, dark and black themes
Download all, unread or next ten
Move to the top of the queue
Find a series in your sources
All categories stay expanded. Search narrows this same list; each label opens a precise docs section.
Draft only: labels and destinations must pass source and documentation review before release.
